card.name: Small words before big named places or events
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, of, and, in, to) that come right before a large proper name such as a state, country, galaxy or war. Often in size comparisons or history facts in general web text.

modes.label: Size comparisons
modes.description: The word of or the in a comparison of area or size, just before a named place.
modes.example: making it larger than<< the>> state of Vermont or five major national parks

modes.label: History and politics links
modes.description: A linking word before a named historical body, war or place.
modes.example: states seceded from the Union and sent legislators<< to>> the Confederate Congress

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words that come just before a big named place or event, especially when something is being compared in size.
